about: How a list of worked invocations is spaced. One example reads the same however it is written down, so the thing worth pinning is a list: the blank line between entries, none above the first or below the last, and the same rule on both pages. The short page prints a header and the command; the long page puts the description between them.

vectors.doc: Three examples, two of them headed and described and one bare, so the separator is pinned between entries of different heights rather than between two identical ones.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
about "An example"
flag "--force" help="Do it anyway"
example "ex --force" header="Force it" help="Skips the prompt"
example "ex" header="Ask first" help="The usual way"
example "ex --force | tee log"
